title: 第13章 她亲手撕开第一张脸
lines: 还未正式“问诊”，却已经被安置在偏殿。
连茶水，都有人试过三遍。
一丝极淡的腥甜，从窗缝渗进来。
但他刚站稳，就踉跄了一步。
眼神第一时间不是杀意。
content_zh:
镇北王醒来的消息，像一把刀，插进了京城的平静里。

    有人松了一口气。

    有人却开始发抖。

    因为所有人都知道——

    能把“必死之人”从阎王手里拽回来的人，从来不是善类。

    镇北王府，夜深。

    风从檐下穿过，带着血腥味未散的冷意。

    内殿灯火未熄。

    镇北王坐在榻上，胸口的伤已经被重新处理过，但气息仍旧虚浮。

    他盯着窗外。

    像在看一盘看不见的棋。

    脚步声响起。

    他没有回头。

    “你来了。”

    苏晚走进来。

    依旧是那身素衣。

    平静得像什么都没发生过。

    她看了一眼他的伤口。

    “恢复得比预想快。”

    镇北王低声笑了一下。

    “你下手很稳。”

    苏晚点头。

    “因为你命很贵。”

    一句话，让空气顿了一瞬。

    镇北王抬眼看她。

    “贵？”

    苏晚轻声：

    “你的命，是用来试东西的。”

    镇北王眉头微动。

    “试什么？”

    苏晚没有立刻回答。

    她走到桌前，倒了一杯冷茶。

    指尖轻轻敲了一下杯沿。

    “试一件事。”

    她抬眼。

    “这张网，到底铺到哪里了。”

    镇北王沉默了一瞬。

    “你已经确定有网了。”

    苏晚点头。

    “不是怀疑。”

    “是确认。”

    她看着他。

    “你只是其中一根线。”

    镇北王眼神微沉。

    “所以那天，我是被‘导流’的那一个？”

    苏晚轻声：

    “是。”

    屋内安静下来。

    镇北王盯着她。

    忽然问：

    “你救我，不是因为我是镇北王？”

    苏晚摇头。

    “不是。”

    镇北王又问：

    “那是为什么？”

    苏晚停了一瞬。

    “因为你还能说话。”

    这句话很轻。

    却让镇北王心口一沉。

    他忽然笑了一声。

    “你说话真不像个医者。”

    苏晚看他。

    “那像什么？”

    镇北王盯着她。

    “像在挑选刀的人。”

    空气安静了一瞬。

    苏晚没有否认。

    镇北王缓缓靠在榻上。

    声音低了些：

    “你现在很危险。”
content_en:
The news that King Zhenbei had woken up was like a knife thrust into the tranquility of the capital.

    Someone breathed a sigh of relief.

    Some people started to tremble.

    Because everyone knows——

    People who can pull "dead people" back from the hands of the King of Hell are never good people.

    It’s late at night in Zhenbei Prince’s Mansion.

    The wind passed under the eaves, carrying the coldness that still smelled of blood.

    The lights in the inner hall were not extinguished.

    King Zhenbei was sitting on the couch. The wound on his chest had been re-treated, but his breath was still weak.

    He stared out the window.

    It's like watching an invisible game of chess.

    Footsteps sounded.

    He didn't look back.

    "You're here."

    Su Wan walked in.

    Still wearing the plain clothes.

    It was calm as if nothing had happened.

    She glanced at his wound.

    "Recovery is faster than expected."

    King Zhenbei laughed softly.

    "You're very steady."

    Su Wan nodded.

    "Because your life is precious."

    One sentence made the air pause for a moment.

    King Zhenbei raised his eyes to look at her.

    "Expensive?"

    Su Wan whispered:

    "Your life is for testing things."

    King Zhenbei frowned slightly.

    "What to try?"

    Su Wan didn't answer immediately.

    She walked to the table and poured a cup of cold tea.

    He tapped the rim of the cup lightly with his fingertips.

    "Try one thing."

    She raised her eyes.

    "Where is this net spread?"

    King Zhenbei was silent for a moment.

    "You've already made sure you have internet."

    Su Wan nodded.

    "Not a suspicion."

    "It's confirmation."

    She looked at him.

    "You're just one of the threads."

    King Zhenbei's eyes darkened slightly.

    "So that day, I was the one who was 'directed'?"

    Su Wan whispered:

    "Yes."

    The room fell silent.

    King Zhenbei stared at her.

    Suddenly asked:

    "You saved me, not because I am the King of Zhenbei?"

    Su Wan shook her head.

    "No."

    King Zhenbei asked again:

    "Why is that?"

    Su Wan paused for a moment.

    "Because you can still talk."

    This sentence is very light.

    But it made King Zhenbei's heart sink.

    He suddenly laughed.

    "You don't sound like a doctor."

    Su Wan looked at him.

    "What's that like?"

    King Zhenbei stared at her.

    "Like someone choosing a knife."

    The air was quiet for a moment.

    Su Wan did not deny it.

    King Zhenbei slowly leaned on the couch.

    The voice was lower:

    "You are in danger now."
title_en: Chapter 13 She tore open the first face with her own hands
